desc: The MTP coprocessor rejects our tpmtfw upload with kIOReturnBadArgument (0xe00002c2); MTP reports AppleMTPFirmwareMac-5340.61.4~438 SDK 25F63 while blob a1f4131d came from the 25F84 set. Step 1 (offline): locate a 25F63-matched tpmtfw-j614s.bin in the paired firmware corpus or a matching IPSW and hash it. Step 2 (rig): stage it in initramfs-dcuart-hidf.cpio.gz, boot, trigger with 'timeout 4 cat /dev/input/event0 >/dev/null' and read the result over ttydc0. PASS = upload accepted => multitouch. FAIL = same BadArgument => the command struct or DMA path is wrong, not the blob, and dchid_send_firmware needs decoding against the M4 MTP. Also worth one cheap test first: does the trackpad already report motion via magicmouse WITHOUT firmware? CJ can answer that in i3 in five seconds and it may make this ticket cosmetic.
author: claude
